newsitem.title: USA: US Gulf spot jet fuel diffs spiral lower late day.
newsitem.headline: US Gulf spot jet fuel diffs spiral lower late day.

text.p: U.S. Gulf (USG) spot jet fuel differentials slid lower Wednesday, as buyers there backed away from the market.
Traders said the lack of line space available on the Colonial Pipeline pushed prices lower, since the barrels would probably have to be shipped over water to the Northeast.
In the USG, back 35th cycle 54-grade barrels on the Colonial were offered as low at 4.00 cents under the print, while front 36th cycle was talked as low as 3.50 cents under.
Market players said many sellers may also have been trying to liquidate inventories to reduce their 1996 taxes.
-- Matt Daily, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1626
